description: Commercial operations announced: Northland Power announced that Oneida had entered commercial operations.
Consultation opened on proposed Decision Statement amendments: IAAC invited review of a draft analysis and proposed amendments through September 24, 2026.

project_name: Canadian International Airports — Global Investor Leasing & Infrastructure Hubs
description: Carney announces Canadian International Airport Global Investor Leasing Hubs at Economic Summit: At the Canada Economic Growth Summit, Advisory Chair Mark Carney unveiled the federal strategy to convert major international airport ground leases into global investor leasing hubs, unlocking private pension and institutional financing for mega-hubs.
First construction hold point removed: CNSC states that the first regulatory hold point was removed, allowing the licensed construction sequence to progress.
Federal impact assessment decision statement issued: The federal impact assessment decision phase completed and the project entered post-decision follow-up, subject to permits and conditions.
